page.overview:
Who is Adrian?

Adrian (b. 1959 or 1960) was a wizard who worked as a photographer. During his school years at Hogwarts, he was a member of the Slug Club.

Adrian was born in either 1959 or 1960. He began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the 1971–1972 school year, and, at some point, was made a member of the Slug Club by his Potions Master, Horace Slughorn. Slughorn had high expectations on the future of this student. Adrian eventually graduated in 1978.

Adrian grew up to be a photographer, to Slughorn's disappointment, as he hoped more of him. The professor still maintained, however, a good relationship with him.

On 20 December 1996, Adrian attended a Christmas party at Hogwarts Castle, held by his former professor, Horace Slughorn. Slughorn introduced Harry Potter to him, and he took a picture of Harry and Slughorn together. By March of the following year, Slughorn kept this picture on the front and centre of "the shelf".
